title: Green Account (savings): Mobile banking and deposit limits
summary: This document lists Green Account (savings) mobile banking limits: mobile check deposits are capped at $3,000 per day, and outgoing transfers via mobile/online banking are capped at $5,000 total per day. It also provides endorsement/legibility tips and advises retaining original checks until funds appear.
